VBO:0200396.summary: Friendly, confident and inquisitive in its breed standard, the Murray River Retriever is an Australian gundog with a versatile working history. It finds, flushes and retrieves birds with a soft mouth, and also tracks game. Its breed association also notes a love of swimming simply for pleasure.
VBO:0200396.shortDescription: A friendly, inquisitive Australian retriever with versatile gundog skills and a fondness for swimming.

VBO:0201359.summary: The American Stock Dog Registry describes its Toy Australian Shepherd as an intelligent, eager worker with a reserved streak around strangers. This is its 10–13.99-inch size variety, sharing a standard with larger Aussies. That standard emphasizes herding, agility and enthusiasm for assigned tasks.
VBO:0201359.shortDescription: An eager, attentive Aussie in the registry’s toy size, with shared herding ideals and reserve around strangers.
